name: Satan
description: Chief of the demons and Prince of Hell, an angel who fell through pride and swore vengeance on mankind; also called Lucifer and the Devil.

name: Iblis
description: In Islamic cosmology, a jinn loyal to God who led the angels against the jinn, then refused to worship Adam out of pride and was cast into Hell; afterwards called Shaitan.

name: Aelfric
description: 11th-century theologian whose De Initio Creaturae argued Lucifer's rebellion left a gap in the heavenly host filled by the creation of man.

name: De Initio Creaturae
description: 11th-century treatise by Aelfric on Lucifer's rebellion and the gap it left among the angelic choirs.

name: Adam
description: The first man, created by God in his likeness; tempted via Eve to eat the forbidden fruit, and later took the demoness Lilith as consort.

name: Eve
description: The first woman, whom Satan caused to eat the forbidden fruit, bringing about man's fall.

name: Lilith
description: Demoness of prostitution, wife of Iblis and concubine of Adam; Queen of Tempters sharing leadership of the ninth order, depicted as a naked woman with a serpent's tail, enemy of infants.

name: Eisheth Zenunim
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Naameh
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Agrat bat Mahlat
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Dasim
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over discord.

name: Al-Awar
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over debauchery.

name: Sut
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over lies.

name: Tir
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over fatal accidents.

name: Zalambur
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over mercantile dishonesty.

name: Maskim
description: The nine archdemons heading the nine orders of demons, the ruling council that advises the Devil; each has Infernal Might 75.

name: Beelzebub
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the False Gods; called Beelzebul (Lord of Heaven) as an angel and Beelzebub (Lord of the Dunghill) after the fall, often depicted as a monstrous fly.

name: Pytho
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Spirits of Deceit, who has lied to prophets and oracles and is believed to have been the serpent in Eden.

name: Belial
description: One of the Maskim, Commander of the Vessels of Iniquity and Prince of Darkness, spirit of hatred, deception and error; Hell's prelate, equated with the Antichrist.

name: Dumah
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the Avengers of Evil, the Angel of the Silence of Death, a thousand-eyed angel armed with a fiery rod.

name: Semyaza
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the Deluders and foremost of the Grigori, who taught mankind the secrets of Infernal powers and descended to earth with the Watchers.

name: Meririm
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Powers of the Air and lord of thunder and lightning in Hell, called the meridian devil.

name: Abaddon
description: One of the Maskim, of the Furies; the 'angel of the abyss' of Revelation who will emerge at the fifth trump to destroy mankind.

name: Astaroth
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Accusing Angels and once a seraph; Prime Minister of Hell and co-signatory of all diabolic pacts, appearing as an angel astride a dragon.

name: Ashmodai
description: King of Tempters, co-leader of the ninth order with Lilith; eldest child of Adam and Lilith, winged and terrible in aspect.

name: Azael
description: Fallen angel who descended to earth with Semyaza leading the Watchers.

name: Harut and Marut
description: Qur'anic names for Semyaza and Azael, the angels who descended to earth.

name: Watchers
description: Angels who descended to earth, mingled with mankind, taught sorcery and warfare and fathered giants, becoming celestial demons; a family of powerful Deluders (Might 40).

name: Nephilim
description: Children of angelic fathers and mortal mothers, of intermediate nature, who became terrestrial demons upon death.

name: Michael (archangel)
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Gabriel
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Raphael
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Uriel
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Suryal
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Azazel
description: Fallen being to whom I Enoch ascribes all sin and whom the Apocalypse of Abraham condemns to dwell upon the earth.

name: Michael (demon)
description: Demon from the ArM5 bestiary, reassigned as a Tempter with the Obsession Sensitive to Mockery.

name: Bartholomew
description: Demon from the ArM5 bestiary, a Spirit of Deceit whose Obsession is Avarice, used as an example of the Obsession Power.

name: Polandrus
description: Demon from the ArM5 bestiary in wolf shape, a Fury with the Obsession of Secrecy rather than a Corrupt Beast.

name: Moratamis of Guernicus
description: Example magus who studies a book of Infernal Lore to learn the True Name of Gaap.

name: Gaap
description: A Demon Prince of Hell of the False Gods (Might 10) whose True Name Moratamis learns; a Corrupter.

name: Kushiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Rigid One of God.

name: Shofiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Judge of God.

name: Makatiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Plague of God.

name: Pusiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Fire of God.

name: Rogziel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Wrath of God.

name: Five Angels of Punishment
description: Five angels of punishment Moses encountered in the Second Heaven per the Midrash Tehillin: Af, Hemah, Meshabber, Hesmed and Mashith.

name: Af
description: Angel of punishment who deals with murderers.

name: Hemah
description: Angel of punishment who revenges idolatry.

name: Meshabber
description: Angel of punishment who punishes incest.

name: Hesmed
description: The angel of annihilation among the five angels of punishment.

name: Mashith
description: Angel of punishment who punishes the wicked through the death of their children.

name: Moses
description: Encountered the five angels of punishment in the Second Heaven.

name: Midrash Tehillin
description: Jewish mystical text telling of the five angels of punishment in the Second Heaven.

name: Second Heaven
description: Location of the Jewish Hell where Moses met the five angels of punishment.

name: Michael Psellos
description: Byzantine philosopher and theologian (d. 1079) known for his dialogue on demons, describing six types of Aerial Powers.

name: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogus
description: Summa on Infernal Lore (Level 5, Quality 12) by Michael Psellos on the nature of demons.

name: Rabbi Eleazor
description: Rabbi of Worms who insists the memunim are deputy angels and dispensers of dreams.

name: Worms
description: City where Rabbi Eleazor lives.

name: Adramelech
description: Prince of the False Gods (Might 50, Ignem), King of Fire who first lit Hell's fires; worshiped in Tyre and Carthage as Moloch with child sacrifice.

name: Baal-Peor
description: False God (Might 30, Corpus), Lord of Filth and Treasurer of Hell, a demon of wealth appearing as an immensely fat naked man.

name: Bomburkhan
description: Tempter imp of the Ruchin family (Might 5) who can make a liar of the boastful.

name: Tyre
description: Ancient city whose men worshiped Adramelech as Moloch.

name: Carthage
description: Ancient city whose men worshiped Adramelech as Moloch.

name: Aethnici
description: Family of Aerial Powers (Might 15), igneous demons of the upper air per Psellos, appearing as flames, firebrands and lizards; Destroyers.

name: Andrew
description: Infernal ghost of the Accusers (Might 10), a Deceiver.

name: Aqrab the Conjurer
description: Deluder (Might 10), a Deceiver.

name: Architechus
description: Fury (Might 25), the Demon Builder; a Destroyer.

name: Ataf the Separator
description: Spirit of Deceit (Might 20), a Deceiver.

name: Bael
description: Fury (Might 30), Destroyer of Nations.

name: Berith the Ennobler
description: Spirit of Deceit (Might 25), a Deceiver.

name: Bordelon
description: Accuser (Might 15), a Personal Tormentor and Deceiver.

name: Decani
description: Family of Avengers of Evil (Might 30), Corrupters.

name: Demons of the Fifth Trump
description: Family of Furies (Might 20), Destroyers.

name: Dibbukim
description: Family of Furies (Might 15), Destroyers.

name: Druia
description: Tempter of the Incubi & Succubae family (Might 5), a seducer and Corrupter.

name: Enervators
description: Family of Deluders (Might 20), Deceivers.

name: Famuli
description: Family of False Gods (Might 10), Corrupters.

name: Fictiles
description: Family of Aerial Powers (Might 10), Destroyers.

name: Fimus
description: Aerial Power (Might 10), a Warrior Demon and Destroyer.

name: Forcas
description: Deluder of the Watchers family (Might 40), a Deceiver.

name: Gavi
description: A dibbuk of the Furies (Might 15), a Destroyer.

name: Golab
description: Vessel of Iniquity (Might 30), Foe of the Seraphim; a Destroyer.

name: Gourmand the Sweet-Toothed
description: Vessel of Iniquity (Might 15), a Destroyer.

name: Guazzo
description: Avenger of Evil (Might 10), a Personal Punisher and Corrupter.

name: Hulikang
description: Vessel of Iniquity of the Merry Devils family (Might 20), a Rabble Rouser.

name: Hutriel
description: Avenger of Evil (Might 25), the Rod of God; a Corrupter.

name: Incubi & Succubae
description: Family of Tempters (Might 5), seducing Corrupters.

name: Infernal Dragons
description: Family of Spirits of Deceit (Might 35), Deceivers.

name: Lickspitten
description: A famulus of the False Gods (Might 10), a Corrupter.

name: Lilin
description: Family of Tempters (Might 15), Destroyers.

name: Lucifuges
description: Family of Aerial Powers (Might 20), Destroyers; Psellos' heliophobic demons who hate the sun and kill by breath or touch.

name: Maggots
description: Family of Tempters (Might 5), Destroyers.

name: Mahonin
description: Tempter of the Maggots family (Might 5), a Destroyer.

name: Mazzikim
description: Family of Tempters (Might 15), Destroyers.

name: Men of Good Intent
description: Family of Spirits of Deceit (Might 5), Deceivers.

name: Merry Devils
description: Family of Vessels of Iniquity (Might 20), Destroyers.

name: Metathiax
description: Decanus of Kidney Diseases, an Avenger of Evil of the Decani (Might 30).

name: Miser's Pot
description: Accuser (Might 5), Bane of the Hoarder; a Deceiver.

name: Morrighu the Screech-Hag
description: Aerial Power (Might 10), a Destroyer.

name: Naonhaithya
description: Vessel of Iniquity (Might 40), a Destroyer.

name: Nithael
description: Accuser (Might 25), the Great Leveler; a Deceiver.

name: Nitibus
description: Tempter of the Shedim (Might 20), a Personal Corrupter.

name: Premnemosyne
description: Spirit of Deceit of the Men of Good Intent (Might 5), a False Prophetess.

name: Rahab
description: Aerial Power (Might 35), Prince of the Primordial Sea; a Destroyer.

name: Reveners
description: Family of Vessels of Iniquity (Might 20), Destroyers.

name: Ruchin
description: Family of Tempters (Might 5), Corrupters, to which Bomburkhan belongs.

name: Sabaoth
description: Fury (Might 20), a Destroyer.

name: Shedim
description: Family of Tempters (Might 20), Corrupters; also a Hebrew name for Tempters.

name: Spirits of Solomon
description: Family of Deluders (Might 20), Deceivers.

name: Thaphaboath
description: Tempter of the Mazzikim (Might 15), a Destroyer.

name: Valefar
description: Tempter (Might 15), the Thief's Demon; a Corrupter.

name: Xaphan
description: Aerial Power (Might 15), Forge-man of Hell; a Destroyer.

name: False Gods
description: Demonic order usurping God's name by demanding worship; appear as pleasing human forms accompanied by an animal; Might up to 30.

name: Spirits of Deceit
description: Demonic order that is the source of all lies, appearing as serpents or dragons and skilled shapeshifters; Might up to 30.

name: Vessels of Iniquity
description: Demonic order, inventors of evil things embodying the most heinous vices, with shapeless natural forms; Might up to 30.

name: Avengers of Evil
description: Demonic order claiming to be Angels of Punishment doing God's work, appearing as immense angels of fiery chains; Might up to 25.

name: Deluders
description: Demonic order that imitates miracles, grants false visions and serves conjurers as familiars; natural form a rent of darkness; Might up to 25.

name: Aerial Powers
description: Demonic order of huge elemental figures causing natural disasters; Might up to 25.

name: Furies
description: Seventh demonic order, disseminators of strife, discord and war, part brute and part human; Might up to 20.

name: Accusers
description: Demonic order of 'accusing angels' that uncover and torment sinners, appearing as traditional horned batwinged fiends; Might up to 20.

name: Tempters
description: Ninth and largest demonic order, evil spirits propagating sins of incontinence, the rank-and-file of Hell; Might up to 20.

name: Kalodaemones
description: Ancient Greek sorcerers' name for the good spirits used in their magic, contrasted with kakodaemones.

name: Demon
description: Any creature with an Infernal Might score; true demons chose evil, unlike Infernal creatures such as Corrupt Beasts.

name: Celestial Demons
description: Demons who once inhabited Heaven and rejected it: angels who fell with Lucifer and the Watchers.

name: Terrestrial Demons
description: Demons who never knew Heaven: infernal ghosts or progeny of demons, including the Nephilim.

name: Infernal Angels
description: Beings claiming to be angels working in Hell at God's command, such as the Avengers of Evil and Accusers.

name: Infernal Ghost
description: A damned human soul allowed to roam the earth under arrangement with Hell; belongs to an order but lacks the Coagulation Power.

name: Corrupt Beasts
description: Infernal creatures devoid of intellect, made evil rather than choosing it.

name: Jinn
description: In Islamic cosmology, the first inhabitants of the earth, forged from smokeless fire, who grew wicked and were defeated by angels.

name: Infernal Might
description: The Might score of demons, set by order and rank, depleted by Perdo Vim to destroy them.

name: Demonic Orders
description: The nine orders of demons mirroring the nine angelic choirs, grouping demons by function and Might.

name: Demonic Rank
description: Titles of Master, Lord, Duke and Prince granting additional Infernal Might and equivalent Reputation.

name: Infernal Reputation
description: Reputation among demons and infernalists of a demon's perceived power in Hell, affecting summoning.

name: Hierarchy score
description: A demon's highest Infernal Reputation including rank-equivalent Reputation.

name: Demon families
description: Groups of demons within an order sharing traits, including a common weakness.

name: Coagulation
description: Power common to all demons allowing them to manufacture a solid body from unformed matter.

name: Obsession
description: Demonic Power imposing the demon's sin trait on a mortal indulging in venial sin.

name: Envisioning
description: Demonic Power to appear in dreams or cause waking visions; the only way a spiritual demon communicates.

name: Possession
description: Demonic Power to control a human host (energumen) using a Possession Might Pool.

name: Energumen
description: A human host possessed by a demon.

name: Shroud the Stench of the Pit
description: False Gods Power concealing the Infernal nature of other Powers.

name: The Wealth of Nations
description: False Gods Power summoning riches from elsewhere.

name: His Master's Voice
description: False Gods Power summoning other demons or corrupt beasts.

name: Change Form
description: Spirits of Deceit Power to change their shape to human or animal forms.

name: Trust of the Innocent
description: Spirits of Deceit Power making a target believe a specific passable lie.

name: Forked Tongue of the Serpent
description: Spirits of Deceit Power making a target believe any lie until he repeats it.

name: The Serpent's Oracle
description: Spirits of Deceit Power duplicating Intellego spells and glimpsing immediate consequences.

name: Form of Wickedness
description: Vessels of Iniquity variant of Coagulation, a shapeless form of visible sin overwhelming viewers.

name: Form of Man
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power to shapeshift into any human after Form of Wickedness.

name: Contagious Obsession
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power making Obsession victims carriers who spread it.

name: Punish the Sinner
description: Avengers of Evil Power inflicting wounds commensurate with the target's sin.

name: Delusion
description: Deluders Power creating illusions, always with a flaw.

name: Duplicate the Magi's Creation / Perception / Transmutation / Destruction / Control
description: Deluders Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of one Technique.

name: Elemental Control
description: Aerial Powers Power to create Creo, Muto or Rego elemental effects.

name: Recalcitrance
description: Aerial Powers Power making them one-and-a-half times harder to control.

name: Waxing Tide of Humors
description: Furies Power causing passion to overcome sense.

name: Beserker Rage
description: Furies Power granting anyone the Berserk Virtue until they calm down.

name: Endurance of the Enraged
description: Furies Power ignoring wound penalties except on Defense.

name: Betrayal of the Heart
description: Accusers Power revealing a target's secret fact.

name: Whispers Behind the Back
description: Accusers Power inflicting anxiety about secret sins for a month.

name: King of Fire (Power)
description: Adramelech's Power to create any Ignem effect cheaply.

name: Regal Countenance
description: Adramelech's Power forcing obedience to terse orders.

name: Form of Woman
description: Baal-Peor's Power to take a beautiful woman's form.

name: Noxious Vomit
description: Baal-Peor's Power spraying corrosive vomit.

name: Swallow Assault
description: Baal-Peor's Power to swallow mundane attacks harmlessly.

name: Make a Liar of the Boastful
description: Bomburkhan's Power granting someone a talent contradicting a boast.

name: Insignificance
description: Bomburkhan's Power preventing any power forcing him to use his Powers.

name: Misfortune
description: Ruchin family Power possessed by Bomburkhan.

name: Scourging the Infernal
description: Relic Power radiating an aura harmful to demons whose Might is lower than the relic's Divine Might.

name: Relics
description: Supremely holy items anathema to demons, bearing the Scourging the Infernal Power.

name: Demonic Weakness
description: Individual weakness every demon has, chosen from Abhorrent Material, Compulsiveness, Ordering, Protected Group, Running Water or Vulnerability.

name: Abhorrent Material/Circumstance
description: Weakness forcing a demon to flee a particular substance or circumstance.

name: Compulsiveness
description: Weakness compelling a demon to count scattered objects.

name: Ordering
description: Weakness giving a demon no power over anything sealed, counted, measured or tied.

name: Protected Group
description: Weakness preventing a demon acting against a particular group.

name: Running Water
description: Weakness preventing a demon crossing running fresh water.

name: Vulnerability
description: Weakness whereby a substance wounds a demon by touch.

name: Religious Limitations on Demons
description: Holy days and rites limiting demons: Holy Saturday, Yom Kippur to Sukkot atonement, and the hajj.

name: Holy Saturday
description: Day on which demons in Christian lands must abandon physical form until Easter.

name: Yom Kippur
description: Jewish holy day; atonement between it and Sukkot drives demons from a household for a year.

name: Sukkot
description: Jewish holy day ending the atonement period that banishes demons.

name: Hajj
description: Pilgrimage to Mecca granting a Muslim a year's immunity from direct Infernal Might.

name: Mecca
description: Destination of the hajj pilgrimage.

name: True Names
description: Secret-name formulas acting as Arcane Connections to demons and angels, learned via Infernal Lore experience.

name: Synthemata
description: Theurgic formulas similar to True Names used by initiated magi.

name: Theurgy
description: Hermetic mystery using synthemata.

name: Confidence
description: For demons, an aspect of free will letting them act rationally or simulate virtue by spending Confidence Points.

name: Infernal aura
description: Aura in which Infernal creatures regain Might faster.

name: Divine aura
description: Aura in which demons cannot regenerate Might.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural region; Infernal regiones speed demons' Might recovery.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural area of a realm affecting Might recovery.

name: Might Pool
description: Spendable Might points that demons regenerate over time.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance powers must penetrate to affect a target.

name: Penetration
description: Measure of a power overcoming Magic Resistance; True Names add to its multiplier.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Mystical link to a target; demons' borrowed bodies generate none, but True Names act as one.

name: Vis
description: Magical substance often left in a slain demon's corpse.

name: Yezer ra
description: Jewish term for the inclination towards evil, dominating demons.

name: Yezer tov
description: Jewish term for the inclination towards good, absent in demons.

name: Seven Virtues
description: Faith, hope, charity, prudence, justice, fortitude and temperance, which demons entirely lack.

name: Destroyers
description: Demon role winning souls through torment, death and disaster.

name: Deceivers
description: Demon role corrupting mankind through falsehood.

name: Corrupters
description: Demon role directly tempting mankind into sin.

name: Teind
description: Tithe of one mortal soul every seven years a Spirit of Deceit convinced a faerie court it owes Hell.

name: Mortal sin
description: Unrepented sin that damns a soul forever.

name: Venial sin
description: Lesser sin that entails purgatory; a chink demons exploit with Obsession.

name: Infernal Hierarchy
description: Ordering of fallen angels into nine orders mirroring angelic choirs.

name: Angelic choirs
description: The nine (originally ten) choirs of angels, one of which Lucifer took with him.

name: Wizard's March
description: Punishment for knowing spells to summon or compel demons.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: Oath forbidding the summoning and compelling of demons by magi.

name: Infernalist
description: Human who serves or summons demons.

name: Personal corrupters
description: Tempters personifying a person's evil inclination, opposing his guardian angel.

name: Guardian angel
description: Angel opposing a person's personal corrupter.

name: Hell
description: Prison of torment for Satan, his demons and damned souls.

name: Heaven
description: Abode of God and the angels from which the rebel angels were cast.

name: Garden of Eden
description: Paradise where the serpent corrupted Eve.

name: Order of Hermes
description: Order of magi; knowing demon-summoning spells means expulsion.

name: Hermetic magic
description: Magic of the Order, unable to pierce demonic deception.

name: Hoplites
description: Hermetic enforcers who might slay an apprentice of a demon posing as a magus.

name: Fourth Lateran Council
description: 1215 council whose first canon states demons became evil by their own agency.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting in which grimoires describing True Names are found.

name: Infernal realm
description: Realm of power native to demons, embodying chaos, discord and schism.

name: Divine realm
description: Realm of God, marshaling forces toward salvation, and origin of the fallen angels.

name: Magic realm
description: Realm whose appearance Shroud the Stench of the Pit can make Infernal Powers mimic.

name: Faerie realm
description: Realm of faeries; demonic Powers can masquerade as faerie.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in the rules for demonic Powers and magic against demons.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability to perceive invisible spirits, including demons with an increased Ease Factor.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability covering demon knowledge, used to learn weaknesses and True Names.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used with Perception by demons to sense spiritual beings.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Ability cited as an example for possession costs.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Supernatural means that can reveal a spiritual demon.

name: Guile
description: Ability; Deluders have Puissant Guile.

name: Leadership
description: Ability in which Adramelech excels.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability possessed by Adramelech and Baal-Peor.

name: Bargain
description: Ability of Adramelech specializing in pacts.

name: Theology
description: Ability of Adramelech.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability of Adramelech.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability of Adramelech and Baal-Peor.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability of Adramelech and Baal-Peor.

name: Great Weapon
description: Ability of Adramelech.

name: Brawl
description: Combat Ability.

name: Charm
description: Ability of Adramelech.

name: Teaching
description: Ability of Adramelech.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Ability of Baal-Peor.

name: Medicine
description: Ability of Baal-Peor.

name: Profession: Merchant
description: Ability of Baal-Peor.

name: Athletics
description: Ability of Bomburkhan.

name: Puissant Guile
description: Virtue common to the Deluders order.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue of Furies, grantable via Beserker Rage.

name: Greater Immunity to Flame and Heat
description: Virtue of Adramelech.

name: Puissant Leadership
description: Virtue of Adramelech.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue of Adramelech.

name: True Faith
description: Virtue that protects against Baal-Peor's vomit.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Flaw common to the Tempters order.

name: Oversensitive
description: Flaw of Baal-Peor (coitus).

name: Obese
description: Flaw of Baal-Peor.

name: Short Attention Span
description: Flaw of Bomburkhan.

name: Minor Personality Flaw
description: Flaw imposed by a botch against Form of Wickedness.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: Spell that cannot detect a demon's lie.

name: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
description: Spell that cannot reveal demonic illusion.

name: Sight of the True Form
description: Spell that shows a shape-changed demon as mundane.

name: Ward Against Demons
description: Rego Vim spell warding all demons.

name: Ward Against Animal Demons
description: Rego Animal ward against animal demons.

name: Ward Against Water Demons
description: Rego Aquam ward against water demons.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Perdo Vim spell reducing a demon's Infernal Might.

name: Circular Ward Against Demons
description: Ward spell; level 30 is needed against an Aerial Power of Might 20.

name: Pains of the Perpetual Worry
description: Spell whose effect Whispers Behind the Back mimics.
